description: A locator whose issue the workspace no longer holds, and a locator naming another workspace. The first fails with -32003 locator_expired: td answered and holds no such issue, so the reference is dead rather than the source unreachable. The second fails with -32002 locator_unknown without td being asked at all — ids are six random hex characters and are unique only within one workspace, so answering another workspace's locator from this one would return a plausible wrong record.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
